summary: The enhanced prompt introduces severe internal inconsistencies across all criteria: subject identity and count are contradicted (one protagonist becomes five), actions are incoherent and causally impossible, timeline is reversed and duration is logically infeasible (2s total runtime with 18s shots), spatial and camera conditions conflict (locked vs. shaking camera, different lighting), and physics are violated (simultaneous contradictory states). The prompt directly contradicts the original instruction and asset facts, rendering the request internally inconsistent.
